name: app-ai-health-assistant-phone-lying-across-chrome-pipe
title: AI Health Assistant on a Chrome Pipe
whatItIs: A rounded grey panel with a phone lying diagonally across a thick chrome pipe, showing an AI health assistant with a gradient orb, greeting, suggestion chips and an ask field with a black voice button.
whatItMeans: The glossy orb and chrome pipe share a shiny language, and the neutral scene keeps the orb the star.
techniques: Phone resting across a curved metal pipe
Gradient orb as the assistant's face
Scattered suggestion chips in a diagonal band
Black voice button as the only dark element

vocabulary.definition: A tappable pill offering a prompt idea.
A glossy sphere representing an AI assistant.
A rounded frame holding a rendered scene.
